mapper.sql: type_id, name, icon, default_seconds, duration_levels, calories_per_minute, sort, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercise_type ( type_id, name, icon, default_seconds, duration_levels, calories_per_minute, sort, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{typeId}, #{name}, #{icon}, #{defaultSeconds}, #{durationLevels}, #{caloriesPerMinute}, #{sort}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE exercise_type SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE type_id = #{typeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exercise_type WHERE name = #{name}
